mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation_member AS self_member INNER JOIN chat_message AS message ON message.conversation_id = self_member.conversation_id AND message.id > COALESCE(self_member.last_read_message_id, 0) AND message.deleted = 0 AND ( message.sender_id IS NULL OR message.sender_id <> #{userId} ) WHERE self_member.user_id = #{userId} AND self_member.left_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT self_member.conversation_id) FROM chat_conversation_member AS self_member INNER JOIN chat_message AS message ON message.conversation_id = self_member.conversation_id AND message.id > COALESCE(self_member.last_read_message_id, 0) AND message.deleted = 0 AND ( message.sender_id IS NULL OR message.sender_id <> #{userId} ) WHERE self_member.user_id = #{userId} AND self_member.left_at IS NULL
